newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Central bank bond rate drops to 2.475 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Central bank bond rate drops to 2.475 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate dropped to 2.475 percent a month, from 2.516 percent last week, at today's 6.3 billion real sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations and reflected a technical adjustment to the maturity period, they added.
The 56-day bonds will mature on January 22. Today's auction is expected to add 200 million reais to the banking system, with 6.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
